fusions.name: Zigzag Dart
fusions.desc: Flings a pebble that deals 4 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Branching Scrape
fusions.desc: Scrapes dirt out in a cone 5 tiles long that deals 12 earth damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Sudden Jink
fusions.desc: Darts you 4 tiles in the direction you choose, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Either Way
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
